notes: FY2024 consolidated annual-report figures, INR million. Operating EBIT = revenue less cost of sales/services, inventory change, employee costs, D&A and other expenses; excludes other income and associate profit/loss. FX losses within other expenses are retained. Debt includes borrowings and leases. Cash excludes other bank balances. Capex is gross cash purchases of PPE/intangibles. Published assets less liabilities less equity = INR 1 million, retained as source rounding; no balancing plug.
